422: Guts is the protagonist of Berserk. He is a tall, muscular man that swings a huge sword called the Dragon Slayer, he has a prosthetic left forearm that has a magnetic grip that also conceals a cannon.
423: Casca was the only female soldier in the original Band of the Hawk and is behind only to Guts and Griffith in swordsmanship. Her ambivalent relationship to both of them makes her moody and capricious.
424: Griffith was the founder and leader of the mercenary unit known as the Band of the Hawk, named for his helmet which was forged in the shape of a Hawk's head.
454: The old Band of the Hawk's friendly mediator. A former circus performer who wielded throwing knives, Judeau was also well-aware of the world around him and was seen as a confidant for many of The Hawks.
597: A massive dark-skinned man who wielded an equally massive mace. A former miner, Pippin lent his strength to the old Band of the Hawk. He was often associated with Rickert, who he seemed to share a big-brother relationship with.
598: Rickert was the youngest in the Band of the Hawk, being merely a child.
599: A loud-mouthed ex-thief. Corkus was fond of delusions of grandeur and constantly at odds with Guts. He was the leader of his own band of thieves before he joined the old Band of the Hawk.
600: Also known as Nosferatu Zodd, or Zodd the Immortal, an apostle who has lived for three centuries fighting countless battles in search of worthy opponents.
604: A member of the God Hand with a large, exposed brain, eyes stitched shut and lips peeled back. Void is the one who brands the sacrifices made by tortured souls in order for them to become apostles and achieve their dream.
605: Slan is the only member of Godhand that isn't repulsive, but her beauty is the only nice thing about her. As Guts is fighting the monsters off she actually laughs at how hard he's trying and that his fight is the ultimate in futility.
607: Ubik's design is directly based upon one of the Hellraiser Cenobite characters. He is also one of the Godhand, and thus extremely mysterious.
608: Conrad is the giant worm like member of the Godhand. His first appearence is in the eclipse along with the rest of the Godhand, and he is seen as having eyes that do not open, a mouth that doesn't close and hands that are stuck together.
611: Gaston is the coolest non-commanding soldier in the hawks, and Guts's drinking buddy. He is basically Guts's right hand when it came to the strike team which he led.
614: The princess of Midland, Charlotte fell in love with Griffith almost at first sight.
615: The King of Midland is the one most responsible for Griffith's ascension to power. He is the ruler of Midland, and father to Princess Charlotte. During an almost lost battle, the King of Midland's army is saved by the Band of the Hawk.
5059: Serpico is Farnese's companion and unbeknownst to her, her paternal half-brother. During his time with the Holy See, Serpico was Herald for the Holy Iron Chain Knights.
5060: A wind spirit from Elfhelm, a utopia on the island Skellig in the Western Sea. Elves in Berserk can only be seen by the open-minded; the devoutly religious cannot see Puck at all, though he can play with their face unbeknownst to them.
6848: The blacksmith who makes and repairs Guts' sword.
7857: Farnese is a noblewoman who led the Holy See's ceremonial guard, the Holy Iron Chain Knights. Since this position has been traditionally held by a woman, Farnese was appointed during her stay at the convent she was sent to by her father, Federico Vandimion.
7859: A runaway brat turned thief, Isidro dreams of becoming a great swordsman, which made him tag along with Guts. Despite his lack of strength and skill, he utilizes his small size and agility to his advantage, along with various tricks and tools.
7864: Schierke is a young witch-in-training, a disciple of the witch Flora. She is accompanied by an elf, Evarella. She aided Guts's group with a troll infestation in the nearby village Enoch, where she showed how powerful magic can be in Berserk.
7879: The Prince of the exiled Bākiraka Clan, Silat serves Emperor Ganishka, hoping to restore the honor of his exiled clan. While only a human, Silat is still a powerful fighter and employs agility and acrobatic skills as well as various exotic weapons.
7881: The Skull Knight is one of the most mysterious and prolific characters introduced in Berserk, a towering warrior dressed in full armor whose ornaments, especially his helmet, are shaped as parts of a human skeleton, hence his moniker, who rides a massive, ghostly black horse.
7882: Once a member of the Holy Iron Chain Knights, Azan is a chivalrous and religious knight, but eventually left the Holy Knights and became a wandering Knight. After ending up on the same ship as Guts and company, he have even helped Isidro in his training.
26394: Luca is the leader of a band of prostitutes at Albion. Red-haired and fiercely loyal to her charges, she is romantically linked to the Holy Iron Chain Knight Jerome.
29388: Flora is Schierke's mistress, who taught her in the arts of magic and Od (spirit energy, life force, etc). In addition to being a powerful witch of indeterminate age, she is an old friend of the Skull Knight, whom she sees as "still having a human heart.
32488: Mozgus is one of the chief Inquisitors of the Holy See, traveling the world with his group of torturers, sent to root out a violent cult of heretics in the city of St. Albion.
36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
49343: Bazuso was exaggerated in stature, and stood much taller than other men.
55205: A young, reckless prostitute. Nina is a member of Luca's group of travelling prostitutes. During her time at Albion, she dated Joachim, a young refugee. At one time she was a member of a heretic cult group, who held orgies in a cave, worshipping the Goddess of Fire.
73441: Adopted daughter of Godot. She was in a wagon being chased by trolls when the Band of the Hawk and Irvine saved her.
300544: Adonis was the son of Julius. He was a slim child with long, blonde hair and brown eyes (blue in the movie). In the anime, he wears a green shirt, but in the movie he wears grey noble clothes.
